title: The 5-Level Enterprise Maturity Ladder
summary: A structured progression from stateless prompt agents to governed multi-agent orchestrations in Copilot Studio.

intro.what: Five architectural maturity levels for guiding citizen makers and engineering teams from low-risk read-only helpers to production workflow automation.
intro.features: Separates zero-connector declarative agents (Levels 1–3) from connector-bearing and autonomous agents (Levels 4–5) requiring DLP and ALM review.
intro.exchange: Keep mail-drafting helpers read-only at Levels 1–3; gate automated sends behind human approval at Levels 4–5.
intro.m365: Enables tiered governance: self-service publishing for Levels 1–3, IT solution pipeline review for Levels 4–5.
intro.developer: Provides clear architectural gates for DLP compliance, connection references, and Purview auditing.
sources: Microsoft · Governance and lifecycle for Copilot agents

sections.title: Governance & Architecture by Maturity Level
paragraphs: Level 1 — Stateless Instruction Agent: Pure system prompt + conversation starters. Zero external data egress or connector risk.
Level 2 — File-Pinned Declarative Agent: Scoped to 1–3 specific SharePoint files with WebSearch disabled.
Level 3 — Folder-Scoped & CodeInterpreter Agent: Grounded in a dedicated SharePoint library with optional Python CodeInterpreter for CSV analysis.
Level 4 — Connector & Action Agent (Copilot Studio): Uses Business-tier Power Platform connectors with mandatory human-in-the-loop confirmation cards.
Level 5 — Autonomous & Multi-Agent System (Copilot Studio): Event-triggered flows and parent-child agent orchestration packaged in Managed Solutions.
sources: Microsoft · Governance and lifecycle for Copilot agents

title: Zero-Trust RAG, Entra ACL Trimming & Purview Labels
summary: How M365 Copilot enforces delegated permissions, sensitivity labels, and tenant isolation during semantic retrieval.

intro.what: Deep dive into M365 Copilot's retrieval pipeline: Entra ID token delegation, SharePoint ACL trimming, and Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance.
intro.features: Agents never cache a separate unpermissioned vector database—every query evaluates the caller's live Graph permissions.
intro.exchange: Mailbox and Teams grounding respects Exchange RBAC and retention policies.
intro.m365: Sensitivity labels (e.g., Confidential / Internal Only) on source SharePoint files propagate to Copilot responses and block unauthorized extraction.
intro.developer: Inspect items_by_url vs. site-wide scope and validate Restricted SharePoint Search (RSS) interactions.
sources: Microsoft · Data, privacy, and security for Microsoft 365 Copilot

sections.title: Why Maker OneDrive Links Break Team Agents
paragraphs: When a maker links a file from personal OneDrive (/personal/user_domain/) and shares the agent with a security group, queries fail for coworkers because SharePoint ACL trimming blocks access to the maker's private OneDrive.
Standardize on dedicated SharePoint team sites with Entra security group Read access, and audit agent inventory exports for personal OneDrive URLs or overly broad site-wide wildcards.
sources: Microsoft · Data, privacy, and security for Microsoft 365 Copilot
